line: Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 (2026, Intel Panther Lake)
config_name: ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 — Core Ultra 7 365 vPro, 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 14" WUXGA IPS 500-nit touch

specs.display_type: IPS WUXGA anti-glare touch (500-nit sRGB class)
specs.keyboard_notes: ThinkPad keyboard 1.5mm travel, TrackPoint, auto backlit, fingerprint reader
specs.pen_support: touch enabled, finger only (no stylus support per NBC)

battery.notes: 58Wh. NBC measured ~17.5h Wi-Fi test at 150 nits on the AMD sibling with the same 500-nit touch panel.

price.notes: US anchor verified: Amazon.com $1,979.06 on 2026-11-22 for this exact config (NBC-quoted). CAD estimate ~1.35x; CA availability via lenovo.com/ca CTO/prebuys.

reviews.quote: The matte IPS touchscreen with full sRGB color gamut offers decent image quality and can even be used for picture editing after calibration.
Both the AMD and Intel SKUs offer pretty much the same level of performance.

praises: vPro on the Ultra 7 365 for fleet management, plus native Thunderbolt 4 docking
500-nit full-sRGB touch panel is the sweet spot NBC praised — bright, accurate, matte, no PWM flicker
Amazon US sells this exact config under $2,000 USD — strong value vs X1 Carbon
Charges from either side with USB-C ports on both edges
5MP webcam + IR face login + fingerprint reader — both Hello methods work
complaints: Touchscreen gets finger smudges on the matte coating and offers no stylus support (finger only)
60 Hz cap on every IPS option including this 500-nit tier
Soldered RAM — 32GB max on most prebuys
CAD pricing runs ~35% above US sticker; CA buyers mostly wait for eCoupon cycles
Standby drain (~1.3W) noted by NBC on the platform

design_philosophy: The practical touch tier of the Intel T14s: NBC's preferred panel (bright matte sRGB IPS touch) paired with vPro manageability — the configuration corporate buyers order when they want the reviewed 'good' display without paying for OLED.
rating_notes: Panel ratings taken directly from NBC's reviewed 500-nit matte sRGB IPS touch (the exact panel of this config); CPU swapped to Intel Ultra 7 365 per NBC's 'AMD and Intel SKUs offer pretty much the same level of performance'. pen_touch 4 = touch without stylus. Price estimated from verified US$1,979 Amazon anchor.
